candidate_relations.reason: The clinical picture (osteosclerosis, acro-osteolysis of distal phalanges, Wormian bones, open fontanel, normal biochemistry) is characteristic of pycnodysostosis, not MPS I which would show hepatosplenomegaly, corneal clouding, and elevated urinary glycosaminoglycans
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Mucopolysaccharidosis type I is a lysosomal storage disorder with coarse facies, organomegaly, and dysostosis multiplex; does not feature acro-osteolysis or diffuse osteosclerosis as primary findings
